title: Average daily steps by country (smartphone accelerometer data)

source.name: Large-scale physical activity data reveal worldwide activity inequality (Althoff et al.)

notes: Stanford study of 68 million days of smartphone step-count data from 717,527 people across 111 countries (2017). Hong Kong was the most active country studied; Indonesia the least. Global average across the sample was about 4,961 steps/day, shown here as the baseline.
